verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid campaigns are fully dark across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads, meaning zero paid leads were generated. Your Google Business Profile listings carried all the activity — 418 combined actions (24 calls, 266 directions, 128 web clicks) across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision in the last 28 days. O'Hare Precision led with a 42% week-over-week surge in profile engagement, and Forte Metals posted a 450% spike in organic search clicks over the last 7 days, both signaling real local demand that paid activity would amplify. Advance Grinding's profile engagement dropped 30% week-over-week, which is the natural result of running without paid support. The focus now is reactivating paid campaigns so that existing organic demand converts into trackable leads.
